facebookresearch_adversarial-continual-l.create_DiffLoss_module: create a DiffLoss module that computes orthogonality loss between two sets of normalized feature embeddings
facebookresearch_adversarial-continual-l.save_ACL_checkpoints: save the ACL model and discriminator state dicts as checkpoint files for a given task ID

facebookresearch_adversarial-continual-l.run_multiple_seeds: run multiple experimental runs with different random seeds and report average accuracy and forgetting
facebookresearch_adversarial-continual-l.run_tsne_embeddings: run t-SNE embedding extraction for MiniImageNet tasks to visualize in TensorBoard
